# SIPI

Signal and power integrity, explained with interactive models you can drive yourself.
Live at [sipi.work](https://sipi.work).

Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No framework, no build step, no dependencies — every
visualisation is hand-written Canvas or inline SVG, and the maths is hand-set rather than
rendered by a library.

## Run it

```bash
python3 serve.py
```

Then open <http://localhost:8000>. The site also works from `file://`; only search needs
HTTP, and it hides itself when it cannot fetch `topics.json`.

## What is here

| | |
|---|---|
| Topic pages | **72**, all `live`, each with a `deeper` section and its own review date |
| Words | 142196; median 2091 per page |
| Interactive panels | **40**, including four labs and twelve calculators |
| SVG figures | 36 |
| Arithmetic claims checked | **127** across 41 pages (`check-numbers.py`) |
| Model assertions | **965** (`check-models.js`), with **0 claims pending** |
| Mutation coverage | **58 of 58** known defects have an assertion that provably catches them (`mutate.js`) |
| Specification claims | **40 tracked: 17 verified, 21 scoped, 2 awaiting a primary source** | <!-- generated from docs/claims.json -->

## How it is checked

```bash
./check
```

| Gate | Catches |
|---|---|
| `scaffold.py check` | dead links, tag balance, headings against `topics.json`, unwired panels, model contracts, ledger rules |
| `check-numbers.py` | a number in the prose that disagrees with its own formula |
| `check-models.js` | physics — analytical limits, conservation laws, closed-form cases, written to be independent of the code they test |
| `mutate.js` | whether the gate above can fail: each known defect is planted in an isolated copy and the assertion that names it must be the one that fails |

The fourth exists because the third once reached 276 passing assertions while a 6.02 dB
equaliser gain error went unnoticed by all fourteen of its equaliser assertions. An assertion
count is not a quality measure.

Every model publishes a contract — equations, units, validity, and the suites its evidence
rests on. Specification claims that cannot be derived are tracked in
[`docs/claims.md`](docs/claims.md) with a source and a status, including the ones still
waiting on one.
